# Sylva Signer

Sylva Signer is a free, open-source browser tool for signing iOS IPA files locally.
It runs zsign as WebAssembly in a dedicated browser worker and does not require Xcode,
macOS, or a remote signing server.

During normal signing, the IPA, P12/PFX certificate, provisioning profile, certificate
password, injected dylibs, and signed output remain on the user's device. The separate,
optional iPhone installation flow uploads only the already-signed IPA after explicit
confirmation so iOS can retrieve it over HTTPS.

## Primary pages

- Signer: https://sylva.antonp29.dev/
- Privacy policy: https://sylva.antonp29.dev/privacy/
- Legal notice: https://sylva.antonp29.dev/legal/
- Source code: https://github.com/AntonP29/SylvaSigner
- Author: https://github.com/AntonP29
- Upstream signing engine: https://github.com/zhlynn/zsign

## Browser support

Current Chrome or Edge on desktop is recommended. Safari, iPhone, iPad, Android, and
other mobile browsers use an experimental compatibility path and can be slower or more
memory constrained. Local signing has no fixed Sylva file-size limit, but browser and
device memory are practical limits. Optional temporary installation rejects files over 1 GB.
